content.comment_body: Hello, It is known that the [product_name] can maintain its time and date settings for only about 20 days after losing power. Is there any way to increase this retention period to 45 days without using NTP or external communication interfaces?

No, there is currently no solution for this within the [product_name]. One possible workaround is to use an uninterruptible power supply (UPS) with a sufficiently large battery that powers only the [product_name] and not the connected load.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for a way to extend the time and date retention period on the [product_name] beyond 20 days after a power outage, without relying on network time protocols or external communication modules. The community confirms that there is no built-in solution for this product. Some suggest using external hardware such as a UPS, but there is no native or simple fix, highlighting a design limitation regarding timekeeping during power loss.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] to maintain its time and date settings for at least 45 days after a power failure, without needing to use external synchronization features such as NTP or dedicated communication modules.
